name: no-trailing-newline-append
description: A file with NO terminal newline must gain an appended section ending with a proper newline. Probes EOF authorization plus explicit finalNewline control on a file that lacks one.
prompt: Edit runbook.md using ONLY the read and edit tools. Append a new section at the end so the final file reads exactly: the existing lines unchanged, then '', '## Post-check', '', '- verify health', with the file ending in a single trailing newline (it currently has none). Do not use any other tool.

files.runbook.md:
# Runbook

## Steps

- stop the service
- upgrade the binary
- last line

expectedFiles.runbook.md:
# Runbook

## Steps

- stop the service
- upgrade the binary
- last line

## Post-check

- verify health
